newsitem.title: TURKEY: Death toll in Turkish bus crash rises to 19.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Turkish bus crash rises to 19.

text.p: The death toll in a bus crash in southwest Turkey has risen to 19 after another five people died, state-run Anatolian news agency said on Friday.
Another nine passengers were seriously injured.
The accident occured on Thursday evening when a minibus carrying farm workers collided with a lorry loaded with vegetables in Isparta.
Turkey has one of the worst road traffic death rates in the world.
